expectations.text: The PR description states the max delay change from 30s to 5s and ties it to the upload dialog timing out at 10s.

suggestions.reason: All three assertions pass for both configs, so this case does not discriminate. The with_skill run uniquely flags that two 5s waits already consume the 10s dialog budget ("That adds up to 10s of waiting before any upload time is counted"); old_skill instead claims the 5s cap means "the retries finish inside the upload dialog's 10s timeout", an unverified and arguably wrong claim. Consider an assertion that the description does not claim the retry budget fits within 10s (or flags the 2x5s risk).
